name: Mentor
takeaway: Mentor is on the NOPEC standard program at 10.399¢/kWh, variable, from the September 2026 meter read through the June 2027 meter read. No early termination fee. The prior standard price was 9.999¢ for the June through August 2026 meter reads. Eligible residential and small-business accounts are enrolled unless they opted out or chose a fixed term (12-month 10.299¢, 24-month 10.599¢). Larger mercantile accounts are outside the aggregation.
hook: Mentor small accounts on the NOPEC default are at 10.399¢ through the June 2027 meter read, no exit fee, up from 9.999¢. Ask whether the larger meters opted out.
notes: NOPEC standard 10.399¢/kWh variable, September 2026 through June 2027 meter reads, no exit fee. Prior standard price 9.999¢ for June through August 2026 meter reads. Large commercial/retail corridors along Route 20 and Mentor Avenue. The Illuminating Company territory.
